name: Squeakling
look: a short, stout glossy yellow rubber ducky with a flat orange bill, little black eyes, a black tuft, stubby wings and orange feet
entry: It bobs along on rivers and ponds without a care, and squeaks whenever it is squeezed. Its body is light and springy, so it never sinks, however rough the water.
how: Wild: common floating on rivers, ponds and swamps.
